messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] About variance in Distance
parts:
Gajanan

Thanks for your careful interpretation of the output from ds().  Not quite sure where your calculations came apart, but here are my calculations resulting in results that match those produced by summary(ds())

area <- 3422500
ntrans <- 7
ndet <- 87
cv.er <- 0.06767633
cv.p <- 0.0857154
D.hat <- 0.0001915371

(se.D <- D.hat * sqrt(cv.er^2 + cv.p^2))
(cv.D <- se.D / D.hat)

Cfactor.unadj <- exp(1.96 * sqrt(log(1+cv.D^2)))
(N.CI.unadj <- (c(D.hat/Cfactor.unadj, D.hat*Cfactor.unadj))*area)
#  Use Degrees of freedom from Eqn 4.11 of Buckland et al. (2001)
adj.df <- cv.D^4 / ((cv.er^4/(ntrans-1)) + (cv.p^4/(ndet-1)))

Cfactor.adj <- exp(qt(p=0.975, df=adj.df) * sqrt(log(1+cv.D^2)))
(N.CI.adj <- (c(D.hat/Cfactor.adj, D.hat*Cfactor.adj))*area)
